name: hyperbench
source_ref: Zenodo record 7180787, version 4 (2023-10-09): Gottlob, Lanzinger, Okulmus, Pichler, "Experimental Data for log-k-decomp"
licence: CC-BY-4.0 (the Zenodo record). Cite the HyperBench papers (Fischl, Gottlob, Longo, Pichler: PODS 2019, doi:10.1145/3294052.3319683; ACM JEA 26, 2021, doi:10.1145/3440015) and the log-k-decomp paper (PODS 2022, doi:10.1145/3517804.3524153) as the HyperBench site asks

files.content: Run.csv (one row per decomposition run: Graph, Algorithm, K, Timeout, Correct, RunInfo) and Type_of.csv (Graph, Type), among the parsed tables
the 3,649 HyperBench instances the runs used (.hg files)

notes: P6 (projects/p6-schema-width, DESIGN §6.4 and ruling Q1) reads Run.csv and Type_of.csv from parseddata_csv.zip with survey/hyperbench_baseline.py to recompute the hypertree-width distribution of HyperBench's non-random CQs (n = 1,113; hw 1/2/3 = 673/432/8), and the instance sizes from hyperbench.zip. Only these two files of the record are used. Zenodo lists md5 checksums, and both match the record's (API, checked 2026-09-24); sha256 was computed on retrieval. Fetch: curl -L -o raw/<file> '<source_url>'.
